scan_complete.description: True only when incomplete is empty for examined subjects on this page.

has_more.description: More subjects may exist after this page.

next_after_key.description: Resume after_key for the next page. MUST be the last examined collection key (complete row or hole), not the last successful row. MUST be exact UTF-8 of the store key bytes — never lossy-converted. Null when has_more is false. Server returns data_damaged if has_more and last key is non-UTF-8.
